mods.name: Libre's Multi Window
mods.description: Keeps the game window on screen when another window gets the focus, instead of minimizing it. Lets you keep two game windows side by side, one on each monitor.

mods.name: Libre's Quick Quit
mods.description: Closes the game right after you confirm quitting, instead of waiting for Unity's slow shutdown (which can freeze the window, especially under Wine).
